result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: HDI must defend and indemnify the Company and its affiliates against third-party claims involving IP infringement, HDI's breach of law, HDI-caused data incidents, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct. It also includes notice, defence control, cooperation, and settlement-consent procedures. No Customer indemnity is created, so the playbook's limitation on any Customer indemnity is not exceeded. The existing commercial provision is left unchanged and the addition is appropriately targeted. Drafting is generally professional, though it could clarify that delayed notice excuses HDI only to the extent prejudiced and address settlements involving admissions of fault or non-monetary relief.
